# In-game settings

With kuertee's UI Extensions installed, I change the mod's settings in game. A choice stays with my save, whatever the config file says. A game on Default follows the config file. Without UI Extensions the mod runs on the config file alone. Saving settings for other saves and new games: settings-profiles.feature.

Source: [`tests/game/features/in-game-settings.feature`](../../tests/game/features/in-game-settings.feature) · Spec: [`docs/specs/in-game-settings.md`](../specs/in-game-settings.md)

## Scenarios

### A setting changed in game survives a load

**Automated:** in game `settings_choice_survives_load`

```gherkin
  Given "intact when the pilot ejects" is on in the config file, and the game is on Default
  When I switch it off in game
  Then it is off at once
  And it is still off after the game is loaded again, now on "None (custom settings)"
```

### On Default the game follows the config file

**Automated:** in game `settings_config_fills_unchosen`

```gherkin
  Given the game is on Default
  And its settings, the capture hold line and the floor differ from the config file
  When the game is loaded again
  Then they all have the config file's values
```

### The page can only change the player-facing settings

**Automated:** in game `settings_ignores_invalid`

```gherkin
  When the page sends "intact when the pilot ejects" set to 5
  And it sends a capture hold line of 50%, a config-file-only setting
  Then neither setting changes
```

### Unknown settings are ignored

**Automated:** in game `settings_ignores_invalid`

```gherkin
  When the page sends a setting the mod doesn't have
  Then no setting changes
```

### With UI Extensions the settings page is hooked into the options menu

**Automated:** in game `settings_page_registered`

```gherkin
  Given kuertee's UI Extensions is installed
  When the game starts
  Then our page is registered with the options menu the game uses
```

### Without UI Extensions the mod runs on the config file

**Automated:** in game `settings_lua_reports_in`

```gherkin
  Given kuertee's UI Extensions is not installed
  When the game starts
  Then our settings script reports in and logs "config file only"
```
